secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (sb_secret_...) from Supabase dashboard → Settings → API → service_role key. Needed for server-side admin operations (auth, database writes bypassing RLS).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<project-id>.supabase.co). Publishable — also in committed .env.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable key (sb_publishable_...). Public, also in committed .env.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Same as SUPABASE_URL, VITE-prefixed for client-side access.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Same as SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, VITE-prefixed for client-side access.
